 Sam Drury, Emlyn Begley, Jess Anderson and Emily Salley
 Most recent Most popular Incredible scenes published at 19:26 GMT 19:26 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 Incredible scenes. The defending is awful from Liverpool but Fenerbahce deserve so much credit for the way they've kept going and going. This place is rocking.
 1 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool published at 79 mins 79 mins 
 Vedat Muriqi 
 Fenerbahce have turned it around!
 The long throw was headed back to Archie Brown, he looped the ball back into the box and, with three Liverpool defenders around him, Vedat Muriqi gets it head on it to beat Alisson.
 The stadium erupts and Liverpool have got worked to do.
 495 1191 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - AEK Athens 2-2 Real Madrid published at 19:24 GMT 19:24 GMT 
 Kylian Mbappe (78 mins) 
 Well, AEK Athens' lead didn't last for long.
 Real Madrid reply immediately, with Kylian Mbappe racing in at the back post and tapping in Denzel Dumfries ball across the face of goal.
 That's six Champions League games in a row that Mbappe has scored in. 
 131 250 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 79 mins 79 mins 
 Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce threaten again and Alisson has to be quick off his line to avert the danger.
 The home side remain on the attack, though, with an Archie Brown long throw...
 30 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'There was definitely no shout' published at 19:23 GMT 19:23 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 That's another soft goal conceded by Liverpool but this one was more down to Alisson not coming to claim the ball - and either cleaning out Gakpo or letting him know he is coming. 
 I just watched the replay and there was definitely no shout... that's a lack of concentration from the goalkeeper, and it has cost his side.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 94 110 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:23 GMT 19:23 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Villa mopped the floor with this Fenerbache side. "Rebuild season", side in "transition", call it what you will. Absolutely no where near good enough from Liverpool considering the huge amount of money spent.
 Alex, Reading 
 260 259 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Brown has the 'simplest of tasks' with tap in published at 19:22 GMT 19:22 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 It's a lack of communication with Alisson. I think it's Gakpo the ball just comes off, and then it leaves Brown at the back post with the simplest of tasks.
 It's a nice reverse ball from Kante
 50 142 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool 
 Liverpool found themselves hanging on a bit in the first half after conceding the equaliser but they're back on the front foot this time, looking to hit the front for the third time.
 136 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - AEK Athens 2-1 Real Madrid published at 19:21 GMT 19:21 GMT 
 Stavros Pilios (75 mins) 
 AEK Athens are back in front!
 It's been one-way traffic from Real Madrid since the re-start, but the hosts counter at pace and Aboubakary Koita picks out Stavros Pilios , who pokes the ball through Thibaut Courtois legs.
 A major upset could be on the cards here.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 452 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 76 mins 76 mins 
 Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool 
 Andoni Iraola reacts to the goal by sending on Milos Kerkez for Kostas Tsimikas. A straight swap at left-back.
 229 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fenerbahce 2-2 Liverpool published at 73 mins 73 mins 
 Archie Brown 
 Fenerbahce equalise again and it's the Englishman who has scored it!
 A corner from the right is played short, N'Golo Kante swings in the cross and Cody Gakpo's glancing header takes the ball away from Alisson.
 Waiting at the far post with the goal gaping is Archie Brown to tap it home. Level again!
 Image source, Getty Images 
 652 1727 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Gakpo always impacts the game' published at 19:17 GMT 19:17 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 What a great ball in by Gakpo. He has only just come on, but he always impacts the game.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 352 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Good header' from Isak to put Liverpool in front published at 19:17 GMT 19:17 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Yeah, it's a good header isn't it. I thought that he could put it further back across goal if I was nit picking a little bit. It's a good move, Gakpo gets a bit of room down that left hand side, and then hangs the ball up towards the back-post area
 The goalkeeper gets a hand to it doesn't he, but clearly can't keep it out.
 358 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 71 mins 71 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Just like in the first half, Liverpool cause themselves problems as soon as they get ahead.
 A pass back to Alisson isn't the easiest to deal with but he'd still hope to do better than thump his clearance straight into Jeremy Jacquet.
 The centre-back ends up giving away a free-kick but Liverpool clear and Bradley Barcola leads the counter.
 91 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Isak's solid form continues published at 19:16 GMT 19:16 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 It's all smiles in the Liverpool dug out. The two substitutes combine and Isak's solid run of form continues. That's his seventh goal of the season. That Liverpool away end is in full voice now.
 473 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fenerbahce 1-2 Liverpool published at 69 mins 69 mins 
 Alexander Isak 
 That didn't take long!
 Two substitutes combine with Cody Gakpo, after exchanging passes with Kostas Tsimikas, gets to the bye-line and hangs up a cross.
 Alexander Isak is there waiting and there is too much power on his header from a couple of yards out, Ederson can't keep it out and Liverpool lead again.
 Image source, PA Media 
 2716 294 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:13 GMT 19:13 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Yeah I do, [like the fact that Iraola made three substitutions]. Time will tell, but I just think that it was freshen them up and, it hasn't weakened them it's strengthened them.
 339 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Those changes have seen Dominik Szoboszlai go in at right-back. Bradley Barcola has moved out to the right with Cody Gakpo on the left.
 201 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 66 mins 66 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Yep, here come the cavalry.
 Florian Wirtz, Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak are on.
 Off go Joe Gomez, Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz. Both wingers have been lively without any real reward.
 384 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Iraola turns to his bench published at 19:09 GMT 19:09 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 Andoni Iraola is ready to turn to his bench. Cody Gakpo, Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak are all about to come on.
